sources.snippet: This site provides reliable measurements for the performance of popular models. You can filter models using the text fields in the header, e.g., Llama 3.1 405B providers, GPT-4 vs Claude 3 vs Gemini. Definitions, methodology, and links to source below. Stats updated daily. Have another model you want us to benchmark? File an issue on GitHub.
